title: wss: ChatPresenceEvent statusText/statusEmoji have no storage in data model
description: ChatPresenceEvent carries statusText and statusEmoji fields but ChatContact has no such fields. The federation draft's Peer/presence receiver behavior only says to update presence and lastActiveAt on ChatContact — statusText and statusEmoji are silently unaddressed. It is unclear whether these are ephemeral in-memory-only display state (never cached), imply a ChatContact schema extension, or are simply dropped. Decision: document the intended lifetime and storage of these two fields across all three drafts.
close_reason: Added statusText and statusEmoji as optional server-set fields to ChatContact in main draft, with explicit callout that they mirror PresenceStatus fields. Updated Peer/presence receiver behavior in federation draft to update all four fields, with callout that null clears the field.
